title: Unity.gitignore: Do not ignore .sln and .csproj
body:
**Reasons for making this change:**

Some issues, such as Omnisharp linting in VSCode, can be fixed by regenerating project files in Unity.
By keeping these files in the repo, only one team member has to refresh them to fix any issues.

It also seems generally agreed upon that .csproj and .sln files should be kept in code versioning: https://stackoverflow.com/a/65400320/2037431
